notes:
Release candidate for 2.2.0, for playtesting. Foundry v14, PF2e or SF2e.

Changes since 2.1.0

Classes

  • Real class items. Soldier, Engineer, Adept, Vanguard, Infiltrator and Sentinel are now proper Foundry classes with HP, key attributes, saves, skills, weapon/armor training and a full 1–20 progression, in both PF2e and SF2e packs.
  • Class masteries are automated. Power action costs drop by 1 on the sheet; class DC bonuses, Soldier attack/damage, Vanguard barrier refills and momentum, Infiltrator cloak bonuses, and the Sentinel AC toggle all apply.
  • Class feats carry their class traits, so the feat browser can filter by class.

Powers and grenades

  • 42 save buttons apply their own results. Every biotic and tech power, every grenade, and the Tech Armor/drone explosions: when a creature rolls the save, its damage and conditions are applied. Area damage is rolled once and shared.
  • Results reach the caster too: Charge refills the barrier, Reave heals, Energy Drain steals shields, Nova detonates the barrier's HP.
  • Fix: persistent damage (Incinerate, Incendiary Rounds, grenades) never worked; it now uses the system's persistent-damage condition.
  • Fix: Fortification and Defense Matrix resistance never applied.

Mods

  • Mods install into gear. Drag a mod onto a weapon or armor to attach it. Weapon mods now affect only the weapon they're in, and mods no longer use investment slots.
  • Scopes, chokes, dampeners, magazines, Ultralight Materials, Power Amplifiers and more now have working rules.
